_readme: One entry per page with a video slot: every course module by name, and uninstall. Drop the files in content/videos/ with these names (a poster can sit next to the video as <name>.jpg). Until the .mp4 is there, the page shows nothing where the video goes. note is one line on what is real and what is scripted in it, shown under the video, and credits (a number) is the AI credits the recorded run used; the .vtt also becomes the transcript at the end of the page. tools/import-videos.mjs brings in a delivery folder (with its videos.json) and fills these in.

setup.note: A real run on GPT-6.2 Sol at High, recorded for this course. Waits are sped up, and the restart and two still waits are cut. The redeem page is shown signed out, with nothing entered. Computer Use and dictation aren't in this recording.

open-on-localhost.note: A real run on GPT-6.2 Sol at High, from one continuous run of the use case recorded for this course. Waits are sped up.

test-in-the-browser.note: A real run on GPT-6.2 Sol at High, from one continuous run of the use case recorded for this course. Waits are sped up. One browser action failed during the run, and the agent drew with a short script instead.

parallel-sessions.note: A real run on GPT-6.2 Sol at High, from one continuous run of the use case recorded for this course. Waits are sped up. The four sessions it starts run on GPT-6.2 Sol at its default effort, Medium.

uninstall.note: A real run, recorded for this course and sped up while the agent works. The agent used GPT-6.1 Sol at Medium, the default for a new chat. The manual steps are the ones on this page.
